verdict.rationale: Muse's docs imply some multi-item handling (e.g., 'audits subscriptions, flags charges ... cancels what you don't need' suggests scanning and acting on many items), but there is no explicit description of a bulk/batch operation mode, API, or UI for acting on many items simultaneously. A community stress-test report also found the agent's control plane timing out under load, hinting at scalability limits for larger workloads. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-action tooling/API, documentation of batch processing across large item sets, and independent verification that such bulk operations succeed at scale.
